EatFoodRations.name: EatFoodRations
steps: choose secure spot for eating
retrieve food rations from backpack
consume food at comfortable pace
evaluate hunger reduction
store trash or residue securely

DrinkFromBottle.name: DrinkFromBottle
steps: sit or pause in safe location
retrieve water bottle
consume measured amount of water
assess level of thirst
plan for next refill opportunity

RestAndRecover.name: RestAndRecover
steps: find comfortable, shaded resting spot
remove backpack if seated
relax and limit movement
monitor for signs of increased alertness
prepare to resume activity when rested

SleepBasic.name: SleepBasic
steps: choose sheltered sleeping area
arrange clothing and pack for pillow or insulation
lie down and close eyes
relax muscles and focus on steady breathing
wake up and assess well-being

InventoryBackpack.name: InventoryBackpack
steps: open backpack and lay out contents
inspect items for function and quantity
note any missing or used items
identify supplies requiring replenishment
repack backpack efficiently

RationFoodWaterPlan.name: RationFoodWaterPlan
steps: estimate remaining food and water
calculate daily consumption rates
plan meals and drinks for next 24 hours
set aside portion for emergencies
adjust plan as resources permit

PrioritizeEscapeRoutes.name: PrioritizeEscapeRoutes
steps: compare landmarks with map fragment
mark promising directions
list risks and benefits of each option
choose primary route for exploration
adjust plan based on new observations

SurveyAreaForExit.name: SurveyAreaForExit
steps: climb or walk to high visibility location
scan horizon for unnatural features or changes
note distant landmarks or open spaces
record findings in notebook
decide next area to explore

ScanForPaths.name: ScanForPaths
steps: move slowly along forest edge or meadow
search for natural or animal trails
identify which paths seem most traveled
avoid paths that appear hazardous
track directionality with environmental cues

MarkExploredTrail.name: MarkExploredTrail
steps: choose noticeable spot
place branch or pile stones as marker
ensure marker is visible from two directions
note marker location relative to natural features
use markers to avoid walking in circles

CollectWaterFromSpring.name: CollectWaterFromSpring
steps: locate clear flowing spring
inspect water for obvious contaminants
fill bottle safely without stirring sediment
return to base area promptly
store bottle securely

ForageBerryPatch.name: ForageBerryPatch
steps: ensure area is free from immediate hazards
identify edible berry species
gather ripe berries without damaging patch
consume or store berries with caution
monitor for allergic reaction or sickness

SearchAppletreeGrove.name: SearchAppletreeGrove
steps: approach grove cautiously
inspect ground and low branches for fallen apples
collect edible apples and reject spoiled ones
sample for safety before full consumption
record location for possible return

CreateSignalWithClothing.name: CreateSignalWithClothing
steps: choose highly visible open spot
tie or spread colored clothing on fallen branch
arrange branch so signal is oriented skyward
align signal to maximize aerial visibility
monitor signal periodically for integrity

SketchLandmarkNotes.name: SketchLandmarkNotes
steps: observe unique trees or natural formations
sketch shapes and relative positions
note cardinal direction facing landmarks
associate sketch with actual place visited
reference sketches while navigating

PracticeBerryIdentification.name: PracticeBerryIdentification
steps: observe characteristics of found berries
cross-check color and shape against safe species
note differences in notebook
test small sample without swallowing
document reaction or taste

ReflectOnSituation.name: ReflectOnSituation
steps: find comfortable quiet spot
review events and choices of the day
identify feelings of fear, excitement, or longing
wonder about next steps and possibilities
monitor own motivation and hope

MentallySimulateEscape.name: MentallySimulateEscape
steps: recall all identified directions from memory
simulate travel along each path stepwise
predict possible hazards along hypothetical routes
select most promising scenario for next trial
adjust mental map using imagined outcomes

NatureObservationBreak.name: NatureObservationBreak
steps: lie down or sit in grass
watch birds, insects, or clouds for at least 10 minutes
listen for unfamiliar sounds
let thoughts wander freely
record enjoyable findings if desired

InventGameWIthNature.name: InventGameWIthNature
steps: collect small natural objects (sticks, stones, leaves)
define arbitrary rules for arrangement or stacking
challenge self to beat own time or arrangement
record game variants in notebook
take a short break upon completion

HumbleYogaStretch.name: HumbleYogaStretch
steps: select soft grass or mossy surface
perform basic stretches for shoulders, back, legs
relax deeply between movements
focus on breathing rhythm
stop when body feels more awake

AvoidHazardousZones.name: AvoidHazardousZones
steps: scan ahead for fallen branches or unstable ground
detour around dense or shadowed patches
listen for animal or environmental hazards
mark risky zones in notebook
communicate hazard locations if with others

PrepareQuickShelter.name: PrepareQuickShelter
steps: identify shelter from wind and rain
arrange branches or thick foliage as cover
use backpack and clothing for additional insulation
ensure visibility for potential rescue if safe
secure area for overnight stay

ReactToInjury.name: ReactToInjury
steps: pause and assess location and severity of wound
clean wound with water or improvised method
apply pressure and use clothing for bandage if needed
reduce movement or load on injured part
monitor for infection or worsening symptoms

CheckSelfForInjury.name: CheckSelfForInjury
steps: inspect skin, hands, and limbs for scratches or bites
examine feet and ankles for blisters, swelling
clean minor wounds as needed
treat or rest any sore areas
note changes for next check-in

PersonalHygieneRoutine.name: PersonalHygieneRoutine
steps: rinse face and hands with water
brush away dirt, debris from body and clothing
rearrange or air out clothing
remove any insects or plant burrs
refresh self before moving on

StretchAndMobilize.name: StretchAndMobilize
steps: perform leg, arm, and back stretches
walk in circles to warm up muscles
pay attention for lingering aches
drink water after exercise if available
prepare for more strenuous activity

RepairClothingTears.name: RepairClothingTears
steps: inspect clothing for tears or frayed edges
tie knots with threads or improvise patches
reinforce high-stress points with extra ties
test durability by stretching material
record repairs needed for more materials

PatchMakeshiftGear.name: PatchMakeshiftGear
steps: inspect backpack and bottles for leaks or damage
reinforce straps with sticks or knots if needed
use branch segments to splint punctures
test gear strength by loading items
set aside broken parts to avoid littering

CleanWaterBottle.name: CleanWaterBottle
steps: pour out old water and rinse bottle repeatedly
scrape interior with clean twig if needed
refill with fresh water
inspect for odor or residue
repeat process if bottle is not clean
